{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the columns to understand the structure
print(trial_data.columns)

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values:')
print(trial_data.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nDuplicate rows:', trial_data.duplicated().sum())

# Check the distribution of key variables
print('\nDistribution of arm:')
print(trial_data['arm'].value_counts())

print('\nDistribution of severity:')
print(trial_data['severity'].value_counts())

print('\nDistribution of response:')
print(trial_data['response'].value_counts())"}
